# 2107B - 4096-bit (4K x 1) dynamic RAM, N-channel

Package DIP-22 · family MOS-memory · catalogue file [catalog/chips/2107B.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/2107B.json)

## Symbol

| As printed in ND-13.003.01, page 61 | Drawn in ND style | Drawn in modern style |
|---|---|---|
| ![2107B as printed in the 1976 symbol manual](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/2107B.png) | ![2107B drawn in nd style](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/shapes/block-2107B.png) | ![2107B drawn in modern style](../../../catalog/symbols/modern/shapes/block-2107B.png) |

A rectangle for the whole function (or one section of it). Pin numbers are written on the lines where they meet the box; signal names are written beside them.

How to tell it on a drawing: Read the part type from the parts list and compare the pin numbers against this cut-out.

All symbols: [symbol catalogue](../../SYMBOL-CATALOG.md).

| Pin | Name | Role | Active | Output type | Details |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | VBB | power |  |  | -5 V |

| 5 | CS | enable | low |  | controls pins 7; when not enabled: float; chip select (TTL); low = selected; output high impedance when CS high |

| 7 | DOUT | output |  | three-state | enabled by CS,CE |

| 11 | VCC | power |  |  | +5 V |
| 12 | WE | input | low |  | read/write: high = read, low = write |
| 13 | A3 | input |  |  |  |
| 14 | A4 | input |  |  |  |
| 15 | A5 | input |  |  |  |
| 16 | NC | nc |  |  |  |
| 17 | CE | clock |  |  | rising edge; chip enable: 12 V (MOS level) clock; the cycle runs while it is high |
| 18 | VDD | power |  |  | +12 V |
| 19 | A6 | input |  |  |  |
| 20 | A7 | input |  |  |  |
| 21 | A8 | input |  |  |  |
| 22 | VSS | ground |  |  |  |

## Functions

| Output pin | What it does |
|---|---|
| 7 | Three-state output; pin drawn as DOUT with a bar (inverted data). High impedance when CE is low (CE off) or CS is high. Data valid tCO after CE rises. |

## Stored state

Bits stored: 4096


## Electrical

| Value | Figure |
|---|---|
| outputLowMaxCurrentMa | 2 |
| outputHighMaxCurrentMa | -2 |
| inputSchmitt | no |
| notes | VDD +12 V +-5%, VCC +5 V +-10%, VBB -5 V +-5%, VSS 0 V. CE high VDD-1..VDD+1 V, CE low -1..+1 V. Other inputs VIH 2.4 V min, VIL 0.6 V max. VOL 0.45 V at 2 mA, VOH 2.4 V at -2 mA. |

## Propagation delays

| From | To | Edge | Min ns | Max ns | Conditions |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A | DOUT | access |  | 200 | CLOAD 50 pF, one TTL load |
| CE | DOUT | access |  | 180 | CLOAD 50 pF, one TTL load |
| CE falling | DOUT | PXZ | 0 |  | CE off to output high impedance, min 0 ns, max not printed |

## Not known

- Whether DOUT is the inverse of DIN is only implied by the bar on the pin name in the pin diagram; not stated in the text read.
- Reference edges for tW and tCW (written as "WE to CE off" and "CE to WE") were taken from the parameter names; the waveform was only partly legible.
- The datasheet only shows CS set up and held with the address at the rise of CE (2-61); a CS change later in the cycle is not described. The model uses CS as latched at the rise of CE.

## Notes

ND manual: "4 K dynamic RAM 22 pin package". Replacement for 2107A. Same pinout as TMS4030 (which uses VBB -3 V).
